# Dentizor

Dentizor is dental practice management software for solo and multi-dentist clinics in Pakistan.

## Dentizor

Dentizor is one connected product for appointments, patient records, cases, odontogram charting, phased treatment plans, prescriptions, lab orders, invoices and payments, inventory, payroll and dentist commissions, accounts, ledger and reports.

- [Dental Software Modules](https://dentizor.com/modules): explore the complete Dentizor feature set.

## Company and contact

Dentizor serves dental practices in Pakistan. Email hello.dentizor@gmail.com or WhatsApp +92 314 7155433.
